arguments.command: cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"; gh pr view 161 --json number,state,merged,mergedAt,mergeCommit,mergeStateStatus,updatedAt,closedAt,headRefName,baseRefName --jq '{number,state,merged,mergedAt,mergeCommit:.mergeCommit.oid,mergeStateStatus,updatedAt,closedAt,headRefName,baseRefName}'; echo '--- list open assistant PRs ---'; gh pr list --state open --base master --json number,headRefName,title,mergeable,mergeStateStatus --limit 50 --jq '.[] | "\(.number) \(.headRefName) \(.mergeable) \(.mergeStateStatus) \(.title)"'
